interactions.description: Taking ibuprofen with aspirin may reduce aspirin's cardioprotective effect and increase risk of stomach ulceration/bleeding.
interactions.recommendation: Take immediate-release aspirin at least 30 minutes before or 8 hours after ibuprofen.

interactions.description: Combining ibuprofen with blood thinners like warfarin significantly increases risk of internal bleeding.
interactions.recommendation: Avoid this combination. Consult your healthcare provider for safe alternatives like acetaminophen.

interactions.description: NSAIDs can decrease the blood pressure lowering effect of ACE inhibitors like lisinopril and impair kidney function.
interactions.recommendation: Monitor blood pressure regularly. Stay well hydrated.

interactions.description: Combined use may enhance central nervous system depression, leading to increased sedation, drowsiness, and slowed reaction time.
interactions.recommendation: Use with caution. Do not drive or operate machinery until you know how this affects you.

interactions.description: Co-administration increases the risk of Serotonin Syndrome (high fever, agitation, confusion, tremor, seizures).
interactions.recommendation: Avoid concurrent use unless strictly monitored by a physician.

interactions.description: Chronic high-dose acetaminophen (over 2g/day for several days) can enhance warfarin's anticoagulant effect.
interactions.recommendation: Use minimal effective doses of acetaminophen and monitor INR levels.

interactions.description: Alcohol severely amplifies the sedative effects of alprazolam, which can cause life-threatening respiratory depression.
interactions.recommendation: Strictly avoid all alcohol consumption while taking benzodiazepines.

interactions.description: Omeprazole inhibits CYP2C19, reducing the conversion of clopidogrel to its active antiplatelet form.
interactions.recommendation: Consider an alternative PPI like pantoprazole under medical guidance.
